Krishi.title: KrishiSahay
Krishi.intro: Tell us about your crop to get an evidence-backed brief.
Krishi.placeholder: E.g., brown spots on leaves or heavy rain…
Krishi.gatherDetail: We search public sources and show what was kept or dropped.
Krishi.failed: The search could not be completed. Please try again.
Krishi.incomplete: Search coverage is incomplete. Missing results do not mean there are no risks or alerts.
Krishi.noAlerts: No matching alerts found in the sources checked. This is not an all-clear.
Krishi.emptyDetail: No sufficiently supported information was returned for this section.
Krishi.shareNote: Only sourced alerts, actions and safety notes are shared. Your concern is not included.
Krishi.shareFailed: Could not copy or export. Check browser permissions or try text sharing.
Krishi.saveFailed: Could not save on this device. The brief is still available here.
Krishi.idleDetail: Sources searched, read and kept will appear here.
Krishi.counts: {kept} sources kept · {dropped} dropped. Claims must remain tied to source snippets.
Krishi.trailError: Return and try again, or select Recorded mode if a captured run is available.
Krishi.householdDetail: Manage your crop and health cases locally.
Krishi.cropIntro: Get evidence-backed actions and alerts for your crop.
Krishi.billIntro: Check your hospital bill against public reference rates.
Krishi.confirmDelete: Delete this saved crop case from this device?
Krishi.confirmAll: Delete all saved crop cases from this device?
Krishi.casesDetail: Saved crop briefs appear here, only on this device.
Krishi.storageError: Local cases could not be read or changed. Nothing has been reported as saved or deleted.
Krishi.namesOriginal: Location names are shown as listed, without translation.
Krishi.trendProxy: Search interest in {region} over {window}. This is a proxy, not a confirmed outbreak.
Krishi.trendEmptyDetail: Search-interest data was too thin to show safely.
Krishi.videosEmptyDetail: Only channels matching the official agriculture allowlist are shown.
Krishi.refusal: This request could not be safely answered
